opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On Ryanair, search for flights from {origin} to {destination} for {trip_type} on {depart_date} (and {return_date}) with {passengers} and an optional {promo_code}, then select the outbound and return fares.
steps: Open the Ryanair home page, Flights tab
Choose Return trip or One way
Click From, pick or type the origin country/airport
Click To, pick or type the destination country/airport
Open the date picker, go to the month you want and click the departure date
If it's a return trip, click the return date
Open Passengers and set the number of adults, then click Done
Optionally click 'Apply promo code' and enter the code
Click Search
On the results page, click Select on the outbound flight
Click Select on the return flight (if return)

instances.values: Return, Dublin→Athens, 2 Apr–5 Apr, 1 adult, selected FR4518/FR4519
Return, Tel Aviv→Venice Treviso, 9 May–16 May, 1 adult, selected FR912/FR911
Return, Dublin→Paris Beauvais, 26 Apr–2 May, 2 adults, promo code 1000001

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, find {attraction/destination}, set {date}, optionally apply filters and sorting, open an attraction and pick ticket quantities for that date.
steps: Click the Attractions tab
Type the attraction or city, or pick a destination from Explore more destinations
Click 'Select your dates' and pick the date
Click Search
Optionally apply filters (e.g., Free cancellation, City, Category = Tours) and sorting (e.g., Most popular)
Open the attraction you want ('See availability')
Choose the date in the ticket availability calendar
Set the number of adult, child and infant tickets
Click Next

instances.values: Aquarium of Paris, 5 May 2023, opened ticket selector
Asia → Kyoto, 25 May 2023, filters Free cancellation/Kyoto/Tours, Most popular, Fushimi Inari Shrine Hiking Tour, 2 adults + 1 infant

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and availability notify
opportunities.description: On Resy, search for {query}, open {restaurant}, set {date} and {guests}, and set a Notify for the {meal}/time window when no slots are open.
steps: Type the cuisine or restaurant name in the Resy search box
Click the restaurant in the dropdown
Optionally change the date and the number of guests
Click Notify for the meal or time slot you want
If prompted, set the preferred start and end time and click Confirm
